title: Omega Ruby: detailed story guide
notice: Original guide text, not checked through a complete playthrough. Manual progress only. No live story flags, complete encounter tables or all-items database yet.

chapters.title: Littleroot Town: settle in
steps: Go upstairs in your house and set the clock.
Speak to your mother and watch the television event downstairs.
Visit the neighboring house and meet your rival upstairs.
Leave town north toward Route 101.
chapters.extra: This guide follows Omega Ruby, the 3DS remake. Original Ruby has different events and rewards.

chapters.title: Route 101: rescue Professor Birch
steps: Approach Birch when he calls for help.
Inspect his bag and choose Treecko, Torchic or Mudkip.
Win the opening battle and return to the laboratory.
Accept your partner and go north through Oldale Town.
chapters.extra: Choose the partner you like; you do not need a particular starter to finish the game.

chapters.title: Oldale Town and Route 103: first rival battle
steps: Heal in Oldale before heading north.
Follow Route 103 to your rival and start the battle.
Return south through Oldale to Birch’s laboratory.
Receive the Pokédex and catching supplies, then leave town again.
chapters.extra: The rival’s starter has a type advantage. Healing first is more useful than trying to win while already injured.

chapters.title: DexNav introduction and Route 102
steps: Follow your rival’s DexNav introduction on Route 101.
Move the Circle Pad gently when instructed to sneak toward the hidden Pokémon.
Continue west from Oldale onto Route 102.
Battle trainers, catch additional team members and enter Petalburg.
chapters.extra: Sneaking needs analog input. Use the Circle Pad area and drag a small distance from its center to move gently; the D-pad is not a substitute for analog sneaking.

chapters.title: Petalburg City: Norman and Wally
steps: Visit the Gym and speak with Norman.
Accompany Wally for his catching lesson.
Return to the Gym and finish Norman’s dialogue.
Leave west onto Route 104.
chapters.extra: Norman is your father, but this is not the time for his Gym battle. Return after four badges.

chapters.title: Route 104 south: the coastal path
steps: Follow the coastal route north.
Note Mr. Briney’s cottage; you will need his boat after the Rustboro story.
Enter Petalburg Woods from the northern end of the route.
Heal or buy supplies before tackling the forest trainers.
chapters.extra: You cannot cross the sea just by talking to Mr. Briney now. His story event comes first.

chapters.title: Petalburg Woods: help the Devon employee
steps: Follow the forest path until the Devon employee is confronted.
Defeat the Team Magma grunt.
Speak to the employee after the battle and continue north.
Leave the forest onto northern Route 104.
chapters.extra: Small trees mark optional Cut detours. They are not a requirement for reaching Rustboro.

chapters.title: Route 104 north and the flower shop
steps: Visit the flower shop if you want to grow Berries.
Continue toward the bridge and finish the trainers along the path.
Cross into Rustboro City.
Heal before entering the Gym.
chapters.extra: Optional: return later with Cut for blocked forest and route items.

chapters.title: Rustboro Gym: Roxanne
steps: Bring Water or Grass attacks if your team has them.
Work through or around the Gym trainers.
Defeat Geodude Lv12 and Nosepass Lv14.
Receive the Stone Badge and TM39 Rock Tomb.
chapters.extra: Rock Tomb can lower Speed. A Fire starter benefits from a second team member rather than repeatedly attacking a Rock-type weakness.

chapters.title: Rustboro: the stolen Devon goods
steps: Leave the Gym and follow the stolen-goods event.
Speak with the Devon employee and head northeast toward Route 116.
Before leaving the city, visit the Cut-giving house if you want HM01.
Follow Route 116 toward Rusturf Tunnel.
chapters.extra: Cut is now usable with the Stone Badge. It opens optional shortcuts and items, but the chase itself does not require cutting every tree.

chapters.title: Route 116 and Rusturf Tunnel: rescue Peeko
steps: Follow Route 116 east into Rusturf Tunnel.
Approach the Magma grunt holding Peeko and battle him.
Recover the Devon Parts and let Mr. Briney recover Peeko.
Return to the Devon employee in Rustboro.
chapters.extra: The tunnel is still blocked by breakable rocks. Do not try to reach Verdanturf through it yet.

chapters.title: Devon Corporation: two deliveries
steps: Visit Devon Corporation and meet Mr. Stone.
Accept the Letter for Steven and the delivery for Captain Stern.
Finish the employee’s explanation before leaving the building.
Return through Petalburg Woods to Mr. Briney’s cottage.
chapters.extra: Keep both deliveries in mind: Steven is in Dewford’s Granite Cave; Stern is in Slateport.

chapters.title: Mr. Briney: sail to Dewford
chapters.gate: Rescue Peeko and accept the deliveries
steps: Enter the cottage on southern Route 104.
Speak with Mr. Briney and choose Dewford.
Use the Pokémon Center on arrival.
Explore the town before the Gym and Granite Cave.
chapters.extra: Optional: speak to the fisherman in Dewford for the Old Rod.

chapters.title: Dewford Gym: Brawly
steps: Bring Flying, Psychic or Fairy attacks when available.
Use the floor switches to see the route, then remember the path as the lighting changes.
Defeat Machop Lv14 and Makuhita Lv16.
Collect the Knuckle Badge and TM08 Bulk Up.
chapters.extra: This is the remake’s fitness-themed Gym, not the original GBA darkness puzzle.

chapters.title: Granite Cave: deliver Steven’s Letter
steps: Go north from Dewford through Route 106 to Granite Cave.
Follow the accessible route to the mural room.
Speak with Steven and hand over the Letter.
Return to Dewford and ask Mr. Briney to sail to Slateport.
chapters.extra: Later cave floors and bike-dependent exploration are optional return trips. You do not need to fully explore the cave to complete the delivery.

chapters.title: Route 109 and Slateport: locate Stern
steps: Walk north from the beach into Slateport.
Visit Stern’s Shipyard and speak with the worker about Captain Stern.
Go to the Oceanic Museum.
Pay admission and find Stern upstairs.
chapters.extra: Optional: the beach trainers and Seashore House offer training before the next stretch.

chapters.title: Oceanic Museum: deliver the Devon Parts
steps: Speak with Stern upstairs and begin the delivery event.
Defeat the Magma grunts who interrupt.
Finish the conversation after the villains leave.
Leave the museum and continue the city’s introduction events.
chapters.extra: If Stern is not where expected, return to the shipyard and finish the worker’s dialogue first.

chapters.title: Slateport: optional contests and supplies
steps: Visit the Contest Spectacular building if you want to try contests.
Buy healing items and Poké Balls before leaving town.
Leave north onto Route 110.
Follow the road toward the rival battle rather than looking for a ferry to Mauville.
chapters.extra: Contests are an optional activity; they are not required for the next Gym badge.

chapters.title: Route 110: rival battle and route north
steps: Heal before the rival encounter on the main path.
Account for the rival’s starter type advantage.
After the battle, finish the conversation and take the northbound path.
Enter Mauville City and heal.
chapters.extra: Optional: the Trick House is on this route and can be revisited as more challenges unlock.

chapters.title: Mauville City: Wally and a bicycle
steps: Locate the Gym and finish Wally’s event outside it.
Battle Wally when prompted before entering the Gym.
Visit Rydel’s Cycles and choose a Mach Bike or Acro Bike.
Return to challenge Wattson.
chapters.extra: Mach Bike is useful for speed and cracked floors. Acro Bike handles hopping and narrow rails. You can return to Rydel to change bikes.

chapters.title: Mauville Gym: Wattson
steps: Prepare Ground attacks or another answer to Electric and Steel Pokémon.
Use switches to rearrange the electric barriers.
Defeat Magnemite Lv19, Voltorb Lv19 and Magneton Lv21.
Collect the Dynamo Badge and TM72 Volt Switch.
chapters.extra: The badge allows Rock Smash outside battle. Make sure you also obtained HM06 before trying to break rocks on the northern route.

chapters.title: Verdanturf and Rusturf Tunnel: optional reunion
steps: Travel west from Mauville across Route 117 to Verdanturf.
Enter Rusturf Tunnel from town.
Use Rock Smash on the rocks separating the couple.
Finish their conversation and collect the reward before returning.
chapters.extra: This is an optional detour. Do not confuse the remake’s reward with the original Ruby/Sapphire reward.
chapters.next: Return to Mauville, then go north

chapters.title: Route 111 south and Route 112
steps: Leave Mauville north on Route 111.
Use Rock Smash to pass the breakable rocks.
Turn west onto Route 112 because the desert sandstorm is not yet passable.
Enter Fiery Path while Magma blocks the cable car.
chapters.extra: Optional: the Winstrate family offers consecutive battles. Heal first if you take the challenge.

chapters.title: Fiery Path and the northern routes
steps: Walk through Fiery Path to the northern exit.
Continue across northern Route 112 and Route 111.
Use the available rest stop when the team needs healing.
Turn west onto the ash-covered Route 113 toward Fallarbor.
chapters.extra: Strength-dependent cave items can wait until later. The direct path through Fiery Path does not require moving those boulders.

chapters.title: Fallarbor Town and Route 114
steps: Visit Professor Cozmo’s house and learn about his absence.
Heal and restock in Fallarbor.
Travel west onto Route 114.
Follow the route south into Meteor Falls.
chapters.extra: Optional: explore the local houses and the Fossil Maniac’s home. These are not substitutes for the Meteor Falls story event.

chapters.title: Meteor Falls: the stolen Meteorite
steps: Approach the scientists and villain-team event inside.
Watch the opposing team’s interruption and finish the scene.
Leave the cave and return toward Route 112.
Check the cable car again now that the story has advanced.
chapters.extra: You do not need Waterfall to see this first story event. The upper cave sections are later exploration.

chapters.title: Mt. Chimney: stop Team Magma
steps: Take the cable car from Route 112.
Follow the summit path through Team Magma’s forces.
Defeat the administrator and Maxie as the story requires.
Inspect the machine and recover the Meteorite before descending.
chapters.extra: Heal between fights if needed; there is no Gym badge awarded at the summit.

chapters.title: Jagged Pass and Lavaridge Town
steps: Leave Mt. Chimney by the southbound Jagged Pass.
Choose the downward paths toward Lavaridge.
Heal in town and prepare for Fire-type battles.
Enter Flannery’s Gym.
chapters.extra: Acro Bike detours are optional. You can reach the town without completing every ledge or hopping route.

chapters.title: Lavaridge Gym: Flannery
steps: Bring a suitable Water, Ground or Rock attacker.
Use the hot-spring floor passages and upper-floor exits to progress.
Defeat Slugma Lv26, Numel Lv26 and Torkoal Lv28.
Receive the Heat Badge and TM50 Overheat.
chapters.extra: Sunlight makes Water attacks weaker and Fire attacks stronger. Heal before committing to the leader battle.

chapters.title: After Flannery: desert or return home
steps: Leave the Gym and finish the rival conversation.
Accept the Go-Goggles for Route 111’s desert.
Choose the return toward Petalburg for the next required Gym.
Use the desert as an optional exploration trip if you prefer.
chapters.extra: The desert is not the mandatory next Gym route. You can return to explore it later.

chapters.title: Route 111 desert: optional fossils
steps: Enter the desert from Route 111.
Explore the sand paths for trainers and items.
Choose between the Root Fossil and Claw Fossil when you reach them.
Take a fossil to Devon Corporation’s researcher in Rustboro for revival.
chapters.extra: Unlike Emerald, this remake does not use Mirage Tower for the initial fossil choice.

chapters.title: Petalburg Gym: Norman
steps: Return to Petalburg and enter Norman’s Gym.
Choose routes through the rooms and read the trainers’ battle themes.
Prepare for Slaking’s alternating active and Truant turns.
Defeat Norman and finish the conversation with Wally’s family.
chapters.extra: Required reward: HM03 Surf after the Gym event. The Balance Badge permits its field use.

chapters.title: Route 118: cross the river
chapters.gate: Obtain Surf and the Balance Badge
steps: Return to Mauville and leave through the eastern exit.
Teach Surf to a compatible Pokémon and cross Route 118’s water.
Approach Steven to trigger the next story event.
Follow him to Southern Island.
chapters.extra: If you cannot surf, check both parts of the requirement: the HM from the Petalburg event and a Pokémon that knows it.

chapters.title: Southern Island: Mega Evolution
steps: Follow Steven to the island’s clearing.
Join the confrontation against Team Magma.
Complete the event with Latios and the Mega Evolution explanation.
Return to Route 118 and continue east and north.
chapters.extra: Omega Ruby gives Latios in this event; Alpha Sapphire differs. This guide does not substitute the opposite version’s gift.

chapters.title: Route 119: reach the Weather Institute
steps: Head north into Route 119’s tall grass.
Work toward the Weather Institute, healing before entering if possible.
Defeat Team Magma inside and reach the upper floor.
Resolve the confrontation and accept the institute’s gift if you have room.
chapters.extra: Do not spend time trying to make the blocked bridge open before clearing the institute.

chapters.title: Route 119: Fly and the road to Fortree
steps: Cross the reopened bridge and continue north.
Defeat the rival and complete the conversation.
Receive HM02 Fly.
Reach Fortree City and heal before looking for the Gym.
chapters.extra: Fly is a travel tool once the necessary badge permits its field use. Receiving the HM alone does not grant every field permission.

chapters.title: Fortree’s invisible obstacle
steps: Check the Gym approach and note the unseen obstacle.
Leave east onto Route 120 and find Steven.
Watch his Devon Scope demonstration and finish the encounter.
Return to Fortree with the Devon Scope to clear the Gym approach.
chapters.extra: Pressing toward the invisible blocker repeatedly will not progress the story. Steven supplies the needed key item.

chapters.title: Fortree Gym: Winona
steps: Use the rotating barriers to navigate the Gym.
Prepare Electric, Ice or Rock coverage while checking dual types.
Remember that Altaria is Dragon/Flying; an Electric attack is only neutral against it.
Defeat Winona and collect the Feather Badge.
chapters.extra: The Feather Badge unlocks Fly for field travel. You can now revisit earlier towns much more conveniently.

chapters.title: Routes 120 and 121: east toward Lilycove
steps: Travel east and south along Route 120.
Continue onto Route 121 and watch the Team Magma movement.
Reach Lilycove for healing and supplies if you want a convenient base.
Return to Route 121’s southern water route toward Mt. Pyre.
chapters.extra: Safari Zone exploration is optional; it is not the required trigger for the villain hideout.

chapters.title: Mt. Pyre: reach the summit
chapters.gate: See the eastern Hoenn Magma events
steps: Surf along Route 122 to Mt. Pyre.
Enter the mountain and follow the route to the outside ascent.
Climb toward the summit and battle the Magma grunts.
Finish the elders’ dialogue after the summit scene.
chapters.extra: If Lilycove’s hideout story seems stalled, complete the summit event and the later Slateport harbor event rather than searching the city repeatedly.

chapters.title: Slateport Harbor: the stolen submarine
steps: Fly or travel to Slateport.
Go to the harbor and finish Captain Stern’s interview scene.
Follow the event inside the harbor.
Return to Lilycove after Team Magma steals the submarine.
chapters.extra: Omega Ruby uses Team Magma’s Lilycove hideout. Do not follow Emerald’s separate Jagged Pass hideout instructions.

chapters.title: Lilycove City: rival and preparations
steps: Heal and restock before entering the villain base.
Complete the rival event near the department store when available.
Explore shops and city services as optional preparation.
Head to the coastal cave entrance used by Team Magma.
chapters.extra: Optional: the Move Deleter is in Lilycove. He helps when an HM move is occupying a slot you want to change.

chapters.title: Team Magma Hideout: teleporters
steps: Work through the hideout rooms and teleporter pads.
Use defeated trainers and room landmarks to avoid repeating the same loop.
Explore the optional item room before finishing the base.
Continue to the submarine confrontation and complete the administrator event.
chapters.extra: Optional but important: the Master Ball is inside this hideout. Check side rooms instead of taking only the direct story path.

chapters.title: Route 124: sail east to Mossdeep
chapters.gate: Clear the hideout and open the sea route
steps: Leave Lilycove east onto Route 124.
Surf between the island rocks toward Mossdeep.
Use the Pokémon Center on arrival.
Prepare two suitable battlers for the Gym’s double battle.
chapters.extra: Optional: explore coastal houses and underwater routes later. Dive is obtained after the next Gym event.

chapters.title: Mossdeep Gym: Tate and Liza
steps: Prepare for a double battle against Lunatone and Solrock.
Bring attacks that cover Psychic/Rock opponents and consider how spread moves affect your partner.
Navigate the Gym’s moving paths to the leaders.
Win the Mind Badge and finish the following town story.
chapters.extra: Do not bring only one healthy battler. Planning both leads matters more than in an ordinary single battle.

chapters.title: Mossdeep: obtain Dive
steps: Follow the disturbance after leaving the Gym.
Visit Steven and finish the conversation.
Receive HM07 Dive.
Teach Dive to a compatible Pokémon and restock before leaving for the southeastern sea.
chapters.extra: The Mind Badge allows field Dive. The relevant destination is not the old GBA Space Center battle sequence.

chapters.title: Routes 127 and 128: find Seafloor Cavern
chapters.gate: Obtain Dive and its badge permission
steps: Surf south from Mossdeep onto Route 127.
Continue toward Route 128 and look for dark water above the cavern route.
Dive and locate the underwater cave entrance.
Surface inside Seafloor Cavern.
chapters.extra: Dark sea patches indicate diving spots. Diving in an unrelated patch does not advance the submarine story.

chapters.title: Seafloor Cavern: the final Magma confrontation
steps: Bring Pokémon that can handle the cavern’s field obstacles.
Work through the boulder rooms and water-current paths.
Heal before the final confrontation with Maxie.
Finish the scene as Groudon is awakened.
chapters.extra: Do not exit immediately after a battle without completing the dialogue. The weather crisis and Sootopolis sequence depend on the full event.

chapters.title: Route 126: enter Sootopolis
steps: Travel to the circular rock formation on Route 126.
Dive in the surrounding dark water.
Find the underwater opening through the rock wall.
Enter it and surface inside Sootopolis.
chapters.extra: The city cannot be entered simply by Surfing over its outer rock wall. Use the underwater entrance.

chapters.title: Sootopolis: approach the Cave of Origin
chapters.gate: Enter the city during the crisis
steps: Find Steven, Wallace and the people involved in the weather event.
Finish the story conversations that grant cave access.
Heal and buy catching supplies before entering.
Save normally inside the game before the legendary encounter.
chapters.extra: The city’s final Gym comes after resolving the crisis. Trying the Gym door first will not bypass the story.

chapters.title: Cave of Origin: Groudon
chapters.gate: Gain access during the Sootopolis crisis
steps: Descend through the cave and follow the event’s instructions.
Use the supplied suit when the story calls for it.
Reach Groudon and complete the encounter.
Finish the post-crisis conversations before continuing to the Gym.
chapters.extra: Primal Groudon’s harsh sunlight nullifies Water attacks. Choose another plan rather than repeatedly using a move the weather cancels.

chapters.title: Sootopolis Gym: Wallace
steps: Prepare Electric or Grass coverage for the Water-focused team.
Follow the ice-floor puzzle carefully; revisit a room if a wrong step breaks your route.
Defeat Wallace and collect the Rain Badge.
Finish the dialogue about the League route and Waterfall.
chapters.extra: Required for the League approach: HM05 Waterfall and permission to use it outside battle.

chapters.title: Ever Grande City: the waterfall entrance
chapters.gate: Earn all eight badges and obtain Waterfall
steps: Travel toward Route 128 and the eastern sea route.
Find Ever Grande’s large waterfall.
Use Waterfall to reach the upper landing.
Heal at the Pokémon Center before entering Victory Road.
chapters.extra: Bring your needed field moves and healing supplies before starting the cave.

chapters.title: Victory Road: the League approach
steps: Navigate the cave floors, ladders and outdoor sections.
Keep healing reserves for the important trainer encounter near the end.
Defeat Wally and finish the conversation.
Reach the Pokémon League and make your final purchases.
chapters.extra: Optional side items can be collected on a return trip. Your immediate objective is the League exit, not every cave detour.

chapters.title: Pokémon League: prepare for five battles
steps: Review your team’s move coverage and held items.
Buy healing items, status cures and PP restoration where available.
Save normally before committing to the League run.
Prepare for Dark, Ghost, Ice and Dragon specialists before Champion Steven.
chapters.extra: A balanced team and recovery between battles are more useful than trying to make a single attacker solve every matchup.

chapters.title: Elite Four: Sidney
steps: Use Fighting, Bug or Fairy coverage where the opponent’s full typing permits it.
Check dual types before choosing a move.
Heal the team after winning.
Proceed through the League without leaving the challenge.
chapters.extra: This page gives battle planning, not a live matchup calculation. The 3DS party and battle readers are not implemented yet.

chapters.title: Elite Four: Phoebe
steps: Use suitable Ghost or Dark coverage and watch for status problems.
Avoid Normal and Fighting attacks against Ghost immunity unless a move or ability changes that interaction.
Cure status and heal after the battle.
Continue toward Glacia.

chapters.title: Elite Four: Glacia
steps: Check the opponent’s second type before assuming Fire is always the best answer.
Keep a response to Water/Ice Pokémon as well as pure Ice targets.
Manage healing and remaining move PP.
Continue after winning.

chapters.title: Elite Four: Drake
steps: Prepare Ice, Dragon or Fairy attacks with the relevant matchups in mind.
Remember that some Dragon opponents have secondary types that change their weaknesses.
Heal fully and restore important move PP after the win.
Save if you want a checkpoint before the Champion.

chapters.title: Champion Steven
steps: Prepare coverage for Steel, Rock and Psychic combinations.
Do not rely on one attack type to handle his entire mixed team.
Keep an answer for Mega Metagross and heal when a safe turn permits it.
Win and finish the Hall of Fame and ending scenes.
chapters.extra: The game continues after the credits. Load your save again for the Delta Episode.

chapters.title: Delta Episode: Littleroot and Petalburg
chapters.gate: Become Champion and load the save again
steps: Finish the opening home conversations and meet Zinnia.
Visit the rival’s house to learn about the stolen Key Stone.
Travel to Petalburg and help Wally against Courtney.
Answer Steven’s call and go to Rustboro.

chapters.title: Delta Episode: Devon and Granite Cave
steps: Meet Steven and Mr. Stone at Devon Corporation.
Learn why the meteorite material is needed.
Return to Granite Cave’s mural room.
Battle Zinnia and finish the event for the Meteorite Shard.

chapters.title: Delta Episode: Mossdeep and Meteor Falls
steps: Bring the shard to the Mossdeep Space Center.
Finish the explanation and Zinnia’s interruption.
Travel to Meteor Falls for the next investigation.
Use the necessary cave traversal moves to reach the deeper story location.

chapters.title: Delta Episode: Devon, hideout and Space Center
steps: Return to Devon and resolve the attack there.
Follow the story lead back to Team Magma’s hideout in Lilycove.
Finish Maxie’s dialogue and collect the item connected with his Key Stone.
Return to Mossdeep and resolve the Space Center confrontation.
chapters.extra: This segment involves repeated visits. Finish each conversation and battle before following the next destination; merely visiting all three buildings is not enough.

chapters.title: Delta Episode: Wallace and Sky Pillar
steps: Find Wallace in Sootopolis and finish the Sky Pillar lead.
Travel to Route 131 and locate Sky Pillar.
Complete Wallace’s gatekeeping event.
Climb the tower while following Zinnia’s story.

chapters.title: Delta Episode: Rayquaza and the finale
steps: Prepare catching supplies and healing before the summit.
Complete the Rayquaza encounter and the move-learning event.
Finish Zinnia’s battle and the sequence that follows.
Handle the final space encounter and complete the episode.
chapters.extra: Keep ordinary in-game saves before important encounters. This preview has no 3DS save-state interface.

chapters.title: Battle Resort: postgame training
steps: Follow the newly available boat travel after receiving the relevant ticket.
Travel to the Battle Resort.
Explore its training and breeding services.
Treat Battle Maison streaks as a separate challenge from the main story.
chapters.extra: Optional: build a team specifically for battle facilities rather than assuming the story team’s levels alone will carry a streak.

chapters.title: Optional: revisit old routes
chapters.gate: Unlock Surf, Dive, Waterfall and convenient travel
steps: Return to earlier water edges and blocked paths with your new field moves.
Use the appropriate bicycle for rails, slopes or cracked floors.
Check route branches you deliberately skipped during the main story.
Keep optional exploration separate from the required next-story objective.
chapters.extra: The guide does not yet enumerate every hidden item or encounter slot. Those tables must be extracted from the player’s own ROM before claiming HERE / DEX parity.

chapters.title: Stuck: Surf, Dive, Waterfall or a boulder
chapters.gate: A field move refuses to work
steps: Check that the correct HM was actually received.
Check that a compatible party member knows the move.
Check that the relevant badge permits that move outside battle.
Approach the correct obstacle or water tile and interact again.
chapters.extra: HM01 Cut: Rustboro. HM02 Fly: Route 119. HM03 Surf: Petalburg event. HM07 Dive: Mossdeep event. This is Omega Ruby, not original Ruby’s HM numbering.
chapters.next: Return to the relevant story chapter

chapters.title: Stuck: the rival has a type advantage
chapters.gate: A rival battle is blocking progress
steps: Heal at the nearest Pokémon Center.
Train and use another team member rather than only the starter.
Check the rival starter’s current secondary type after evolution.
Use status or defensive turns where helpful instead of repeatedly taking the same unfavorable exchange.
chapters.extra: You do not need to restart because of your starter choice.
